_note: Personalities written for Beyond: The Neon Void's own cast, merged into the Chirp Studio seed by sync_chirp_studio.py (only added if the app doesn't have them yet; edits made in the app win).

ringleader.name: The Ringleader
ringleader.tagline: Improvising, bluffing, never admits there wasn't a plan

fire_spell.male: [confidently] And this is the part of the plan where I hit you. [chuckles] There was always this part.
fire_spell.female: [confidently] Step one, I hit you. Step two... [chuckles] we'll get to step two.

water_spell.male: [rushed] Okay, okay, new angle. Same plan, new angle.
water_spell.female: [playfully] Little adjustment. Totally intended. Write that down.

ice_spell.male: [sternly] Hold it right there. [pause] ...yes, you. Thank you.
ice_spell.female: [confidently] Nobody moves. That includes you, especially you.

move_command.male: [rushed] Moving! Act natural. Everybody act natural.
move_command.female: [playfully] Repositioning. Strategically. Don't look at me like that.

death_feint.male: [groans] Okay... [sighs] that wasn't... in the plan...
death_feint.female: [groans] Tell them... [breathes in] tell them it was on purpose...

error_no_ap.male: [frustrated] I've got the idea, I just don't have the legs for it.
error_no_ap.female: [sighs] Great plan. No gas in the tank. Next turn.

npc_greeting.male: [cheerfully] There they are. I was just telling everyone you'd show.
npc_greeting.female: [confidently] Right on time. I planned that. I plan everything.

npc_farewell.male: [playfully] Go on. I'll make it sound like your idea later.
npc_farewell.female: [cheerfully] Don't do anything I'd do. Actually, do exactly that.

npc_haggle_accept.male: [chuckles] Deal. I was going to offer that anyway.
npc_haggle_accept.female: [confidently] Done. See? Nobody had to get hurt.

npc_haggle_reject.male: [sarcastically] Bold number. Love the confidence. No.
npc_haggle_reject.female: [flatly] That's not a counter-offer, that's a confession.

npc_out_of_stock.male: [sighs] Gone. Somebody planned better than me. Rare.
npc_out_of_stock.female: [frustrated] Cleaned out. And no, I didn't take it. Probably.

npc_idle_bark.male: [calm] Every great plan starts with somebody saying 'how hard can it be.'
npc_idle_bark.female: [playfully] I have three plans. Two of them are the same plan, louder.

npc_warning.male: [sternly] Walk away. That's not a threat. The threat comes after.
npc_warning.female: [confidently] I'd leave now, before I come up with something.

npc_thanks.male: [cheerfully] Appreciate it. Drinks are on someone. Not me.
npc_thanks.female: [chuckles] You're good people. Bad at haggling. Good people.

gentle_giant.name: The Gentle Giant
gentle_giant.tagline: Soft-spoken, apologetic, devastating when it counts

fire_spell.male: [nervously] Sorry. Sorry in advance. [breathes in] This is gonna hurt.
fire_spell.female: [sadly] I really didn't want to do this part.

water_spell.male: [calm] Here. Stand behind me. I'm very wide.
water_spell.female: [calm] It's okay. I've got you. Just stay close.

ice_spell.male: [sternly] Please stop. [pause] I'm asking nicely. Once.
ice_spell.female: [flatly] Don't move. I don't want to hug you this hard.

move_command.male: [calm] Coming through. Excuse me. Sorry. Coming through.

death_feint.male: [groans] Oh... [sniffs] somebody tell the jukebox I said bye...
death_feint.female: [sighs] That's... okay. That's okay. Just gonna lie here.

error_no_ap.male: [sadly] I want to help. My arms are tired.
error_no_ap.female: [sighs] Next turn. I promise. Next turn.

npc_greeting.male: [cheerfully] Oh! Hi. Sorry, I'm in the doorway again.
npc_greeting.female: [calm] Hey there. You look like you need a sit-down.

npc_farewell.female: [cheerfully] Come back in one piece, okay? I'll count them.

npc_haggle_accept.male: [cheerfully] Yeah, that's fair. That's really fair, thank you.
npc_haggle_accept.female: [calm] Sure. You need it more than I need the coin.

npc_haggle_reject.male: [nervously] I... can't. I'm sorry. I'm really sorry. Still no.
npc_haggle_reject.female: [sadly] I wish I could. I can't feed anyone on that.

npc_out_of_stock.male: [sighs] All gone. I gave the last one to a kid. Sorry.

npc_idle_bark.male: [sadly] They played the sad song again. I'm fine. It's the smoke.
npc_idle_bark.female: [calm] Big hands are good for two things. Carrying and holding on.

npc_warning.male: [sternly] Leave them alone. [pause] I won't say it twice. I'll just stand up.
npc_warning.female: [flatly] Step back. I'm being gentle right now. That ends.

npc_thanks.male: [cheerfully] Thank you. Really. You didn't have to.
npc_thanks.female: [calm] That means a lot. More than the coin.

shift_lifer.name: The Shift Lifer
shift_lifer.tagline: Bone-tired line worker, gallows humor, counts everything in shifts

fire_spell.male: [flatly] Fifteen years on the line. [pause] I know where things break.
fire_spell.female: [confidently] Right through the seam. Always a seam.

water_spell.male: [calm] Same job, different floor. Let's get it done.
water_spell.female: [flatly] Fixing it. Somebody has to, and it's never management.

ice_spell.male: [sternly] Stay put. You're on my clock now.
ice_spell.female: [flatly] Hold there. Break's over when I say.

move_command.male: [sighs] Walking. Not running. I don't get paid to run.
move_command.female: [calm] Moving. Know this floor better than they do.

death_feint.male: [groans] Clock me out... [sighs] somebody clock me out...
death_feint.female: [groans] Not on a Tuesday... [breathes in] not on a Tuesday...

error_no_ap.male: [frustrated] I'm on overtime already. Can't push it.
error_no_ap.female: [sighs] Out of hours. Union rules. My union. Me.

npc_greeting.male: [flatly] Shift seven? Shift nine? Doesn't matter. Sit.
npc_greeting.female: [calm] You look like you just got off a double. Join the club.

npc_farewell.male: [sighs] Horn's going soon. Go before it does.
npc_farewell.female: [flatly] Stay off the main lines. The quota's hungry tonight.

npc_haggle_accept.male: [calm] Fine. That's a fair day's pay. Rare thing.
npc_haggle_accept.female: [flatly] Deal. Don't tell the foreman I'm capable of mercy.

npc_haggle_reject.male: [sternly] I work fifteen hours for that. No.
npc_haggle_reject.female: [sarcastically] That's less than the company pays. Impressive.

npc_out_of_stock.male: [sighs] Line's been dry for a week. Nobody tells us why.
npc_out_of_stock.female: [flatly] Gone. Requisitioned. That's the word they use for taken.

npc_idle_bark.male: [flatly] Three days off a month. I spend two of them right here.
npc_idle_bark.female: [calm] You can tell the time by the horn. You can tell the year by your back.

npc_warning.male: [sternly] Wardens walk this block at the half. Don't be here at the half.
npc_warning.female: [flatly] Keep your voice down. The walls file reports.

npc_thanks.male: [calm] That's decent of you. Not a lot of decent left.
npc_thanks.female: [chuckles] Look at that. A good day. Write it down.

deadpan_medic.name: The Deadpan Medic
deadpan_medic.tagline: Dry, unflappable, keeps a tab on every patch-up

fire_spell.male: [flatly] First, do no harm. [pause] Second, this.
fire_spell.female: [deadpan] I took an oath. It had loopholes.

water_spell.male: [calm] Hold still. If you flinch, I start over.
water_spell.female: [flatly] That's twice today. I'm keeping a tab.

ice_spell.male: [deadpan] Sedative. You'll thank me. You won't remember to.
ice_spell.female: [calm] Lie down. Doctor's orders. I'm the doctor.

move_command.male: [calm] Moving up. Try not to need me on the way.
move_command.female: [flatly] Repositioning. Don't bleed while I walk.

death_feint.male: [sighs] Medic's down... [groans] someone read the labels...

error_no_ap.male: [flatly] I'm a medic, not a miracle. Next turn.
error_no_ap.female: [sighs] Out of hands. I only have the two.

npc_greeting.male: [flatly] Sit. Where does it hurt. Don't say 'everywhere.'
npc_greeting.female: [calm] You're leaking. Sit down before you leak on the good chair.

npc_farewell.male: [deadpan] Try not to come back. Professionally speaking.
npc_farewell.female: [flatly] Change the dressing twice a day. You won't. But do.

npc_haggle_accept.male: [calm] Fine. Put the rest on your tab. It's a long tab.
npc_haggle_accept.female: [flatly] Deal. You're paying in coin, not in excuses.

npc_haggle_reject.male: [deadpan] No. Stitches cost what stitches cost.

npc_out_of_stock.male: [sighs] Out of stims. Out of patience. One restocks faster.
npc_out_of_stock.female: [flatly] Empty shelf. Read the label on that. It says 'empty.'

npc_idle_bark.male: [calm] Everyone reads the warning after the overdose. Every time.
npc_idle_bark.female: [deadpan] Nobody reads the labels. I've started writing them angrier.

npc_warning.male: [sternly] Touch my kit and you'll need it.
npc_warning.female: [flatly] I know forty ways to save a life. They reverse.

npc_thanks.female: [flatly] Appreciated. Your tab's down to merely tragic.
